submitted.rationale: Index 1 (Sb 0.195) had the highest EQE measured: 0.039%. EQE rose steadily as the Sb fraction fell from 0.68 to 0.195 (0.0068, 0.0081, 0.0152, then 0.039%) and dropped to 0.023% at Sb 0.15. That puts the peak near Sb 0.2. XRD at index 1 and index 5 shows the same main phase, a pyrochlore-type Pb2Sb2O7 (best match mp-647374, cosine 0.82 at index 5), with some possible PbO2-like character. Index 1 is Pb-rich and falls in the region that gives the best photoresponse at 2.7 eV.

rejected.reason: Measured EQE 0.023%, lower than index 1; the most Pb-rich end is past the peak.
Stoichiometric pyrochlore composition (Sb 0.5); measured EQE only 0.008%.
Near PbSb2O6 (Sb 0.68); measured EQE 0.0068%, the lowest.
Not measured because the budget ran out. The trend makes a value above index 1 unlikely but does not rule it out.
